description:
Get all cancer types available in cBioPortal.
Data: cBioPortal for Cancer Genomics (public studies) · table cancer_type — one record = one OncoTree cancer type used by cBioPortal.
Key: cancerTypeId.
Results: `_vbt.total` counts all matches.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence.
